run_bleu_scoring: run BLEU scoring of generated translations against reference translations using the fairseq CLI
run_sacrebleu_scoring: run sacrebleu-based corpus BLEU scoring by passing the --sacrebleu flag to the CLI
run_sentence_bleu: run sentence-level BLEU scoring with +1 smoothing using the --sentence-bleu flag
run_case_insensitive_bleu: run case-insensitive BLEU scoring by passing the --ignore-case flag to the CLI
review_get_parser: review the get_parser function that builds the argparse parser with BLEU scoring CLI arguments
